title: Worlds O' Plenty II
description: A new & updated curated modpack featuring all sorts of experiences!: - Adventure! - Decorations! - Bosses and Mobs a plenty! And of course... *drum rolls* Plenty of Worlds to explore! - Updated to 1.21.1 Neoforge!
body:
# Welcome to the Worlds O' Plenty Modpack!

**Worlds O' Plenty is a curated Modpack by me, the name's LeeKan nice to meet you!! This was originally created for personal uses, but I wanted to also share this enjoyment with you all as well!**

![ModpackLogo](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1198471245172318268/1499647762940166234/2026-03-23_17.10.361.png?ex=69f58f50&is=69f43dd0&hm=f473c86396d9ca06f16bbaef52364d5f1b9acd6093783e583456e4b6816fdc28)

This modpack contains plenty of popular mods that work together to create a thoroughly enjoyable experience!

# Plenty O' Mods to enjoy!

From the big mods that introduce entirely different worlds and biomes to the more humble mods that add in decorations and simple technological funs, it aims to be something you can enjoy but not be overwhelmed by!

![Portals!](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1198471245172318268/1499648023607771197/2026-03-23_17.38.54narrow.png?ex=69f58f8e&is=69f43e0e&hm=f946f5f8425ffd9faf178e088e8000cfdfcc303651b404a5775d952e4a499e8d)

The aim is always of course, to stack as many different dimensions and worlds as possible without breaking the game + playable! 

With a collection that regularly gets updated, you can expect up to 200+ mods running! Of course there's also TONS of optimization mods to help cope with the amount of stuff going on here! Do still be careful with your RAM usage tho!

## Notable Big Mods include!:
- The Aether (+ Addons)
- The Twilight Forest
- L_Ender's Cataclysm
- Biomes O' Plenty (ofc)
- Applied Energistics
- Dimensional Doors
- Stellaris
- Project Alpha

  ... And **_MANY MORE!!!_**

# Important notes regarding this modpack!:

-  As this is a pretty big modpack, please remember to save up at least 8~10GB of RAM to use!
-  Updates will take time as I'm only one person!
-  If anything pops up, you can join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/9yQjsP2zWe)! I'll try my best to work out any flaws, issues or anything else!
-  I do hope you have fun!
-  PS: Chances are you MIGHT have to download the [Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) mod! + [Umbral Skies](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/umbral-skies) separately in cases where they are missing!
